verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Nitro page's "HD video streaming" perk. It implies Discord has its own video-streaming capability in calls, but it never names screen sharing or describes how it works for live collaboration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of screen sharing during voice/video calls, details on how to start a share and who can view it, non-Nitro availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can share my screen during a call for live collaboration
